hero.title: Your neighborhood bakery, made with care
hero.text: Every day we bake with simple ingredients, slow fermentation, and the warmth of homemade recipes.
hero.imageAlt: Baker taking a tray of fresh bread out of the oven

story.title: Our story
story.text:
Crumb & Oven began with a simple idea: make bread the way it was made at home, without rushing. We started with a few sourdough loaves and the sweet breads that go perfectly with afternoon coffee.

Today we still bake in small batches, combining artisan techniques with Nicaraguan favorites like coconut bread and traditional corn-and-cheese bakes.

values.title: Simple ingredients
values.text: Flour, water, salt, and time. No preservatives or unnecessary additives.

values.title: Small batches
values.text: We bake several times a day so every loaf stays fresh.

values.title: Family recipes
values.text: We keep the flavors of traditional Nicaraguan baking alive.

process.title: Sourdough starter
process.text: We feed our starter every day; it's the heart of our artisan loaves.

process.title: Slow fermentation
process.text: Our dough rests for 12 to 24 hours to develop flavor and texture.

process.title: Hand-shaped
process.text: Every piece is weighed and shaped by hand before baking.

process.title: Baked daily
process.text: We bake early in the morning and again in the afternoon.
